title: Sell Mineral Rights in Seward, PA
metaTitle: Sell Mineral Rights in Seward, PA
metaDescription: Seward, Westmoreland County mineral rights owner near the Conemaugh? We buy oil and gas interests, verify your title, and pay a fair cash price.
heroLead: Seward sits along the Conemaugh River on the edge of Westmoreland County, close enough to Cambria County that some families here have mineral interests that span the county line, adding an extra step to confirming ownership.
intro: We check jurisdiction carefully for tracts near Seward, since a property's location right along a county boundary can mean deed and lease records are split between two different recorder of deeds offices. That's not a dealbreaker, just something we handle as part of a thorough title review before quoting you a number.

sections.heading: Working Across a County Line
paragraphs: If your Seward-area tract straddles Westmoreland and Cambria counties, or your family's ownership history involves land in both, we pull records from both recorder of deeds offices to build a complete picture of what you own. This kind of cross-county confirmation takes a bit more time, but it protects you from an inaccurate offer based on incomplete records.

This stretch of Westmoreland County sits toward the eastern edge of the wet-gas Marcellus fairway, so activity has generally been less dense here than closer to the Washington and Greene county core, and we price honestly against that reality.

sections.heading: What We Need From You to Get Started
paragraphs: A deed, tax parcel number, or even just your understanding of where the property sits is enough for us to begin a records search. We'll come back to you with a clear explanation of what we found and what your interest appears to be worth before asking for any commitment.

faqs.question: My property is near the Westmoreland and Cambria county line. Does that complicate a sale?
faqs.answer: It adds a step, since we may need records from both counties, but it doesn't prevent a sale. We handle that cross-county confirmation as part of our review.

faqs.question: Is this part of Westmoreland County active for Marcellus development?
faqs.answer: Activity is generally lighter toward the eastern edge of the county, and we'll give you an honest assessment for your specific tract.

faqs.question: What's the first step if I want to sell?
faqs.answer: Send us whatever ownership information you have, even if incomplete, and we'll research the rest through the appropriate county records.

faqs.question: Does it cost extra to research a cross-county tract?
faqs.answer: No, we absorb that additional research as part of our standard free review, regardless of how many counties your ownership history touches.

faqs.question: How do you decide which county's records govern the sale?
faqs.answer: We follow wherever the mineral estate itself is legally recorded, confirmed against the current parcel description, rather than assuming based on mailing address alone.
